subject: [PATCH bpf-next v5 1/2] mm/bpf: Add bpf_proactive_reclaim kfunc

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the simplicity of the proposed kfunc, suggesting it may need to be more complex and require clean process context like userspace memory.reclaim.

reviews.author: Kumar Kartikeya Dwivedi
reviews.summary: Agreed with Shakeel's concerns and suggested restricting the kfunc to BPF_PROG_TYPE_SYSCALL, allowing it to be callable from sleepable async contexts or the syscall program.

2026-08-28.patch_summary: The patch proposes adding a new kfunc, bpf_proactive_reclaim, to the mm/bpf module.
